Container.Name: Wondarr
Container.Overview: Wondarr is an *arr for single songs. You tell it which recordings you want, and it finds the best copy on Soulseek first, then YouTube Music, torrents and usenet. It checks each file is the right recording, tags it and files it into your library. Soulseek (slskd), ffmpeg and fpcalc are bundled in the image.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: The web UI and the API.

Config.Name: Soulseek listen port
Config.Description: The listen port of the bundled slskd. Forward it on your router for better Soulseek results.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: The database, config.yml, logs, backups and the bundled slskd's state.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Your music and every download. Use one share for both so torrent imports can hard-link.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The user the app runs as (Unraid: nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: The group the app runs as (Unraid: users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: The umask the app runs with.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: The time zone, for example Australia/Sydney.

Config.Name: Soulseek username
Config.Description: Optional. A dedicated Soulseek account; it can also be set in Settings, Soulseek. A value set here locks the field in the UI.

Config.Name: Soulseek password
Config.Description: Optional. The password for that account.
